episode_summary: In this episode, Kristy Nakamura shares her journey of building a successful real estate business by focusing on niche markets, particularly military families in Hawaii. She emphasizes the importance of leveraging relationships and referrals, using AI for efficiency, and understanding the unique needs of her clients. Kristy also discusses creative financial strategies like seller credits to help clients manage high living costs.
